ui.title: Marey Chronograph
ui.tagline: Stroboscopic motion analysis on glass plate

motion_action.hint: Select athletic gait or aerial maneuver

palette.hint: Chemical emulsion formula and spectral tone

strobe_density.hint: Flashes per second imprinted on plate

listing.blurb: A glowing skeletal figure leaps across a deep black photographic plate, leaving behind dense stroboscopic exposures and luminous kinetic trajectories.
listing.prompt: Chronophotography in the manner of Marey: a figure made of glowing lines on its joints leaps, runs and vaults, each moment left behind on the black plate as a fading trace, so motion becomes a single drawing. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
